prompt: Who was the Prime Minister of Canada in the year that the 1965 winner of the Best New Artist Grammy Award made their first appearance on US television?
answer:
The 1965 Best New Artist Grammy winner was **The Beatles**. Their first U.S. television appearance was in **1964**, on *The Jack Paar Program*.

Canada’s prime minister in 1964 was **Lester B. Pearson**.
